title: RydeResolve
sub: From trip context to a reasoned outcome
narration: RydeResolve gives riders, drivers, and reviewers a shared dispute process: explain the trip, inspect the evidence, and apply policy. Here is the updated synthetic demonstration.

captions.text: RydeResolve gives riders, drivers, and reviewers a shared dispute process: explain the trip, inspect the evidence, and apply policy.
Here is the updated synthetic demonstration.

title: One trip. Three perspectives.
sub: Fair hearing · Clear status · Traceable decisions
narration: A rider needs an explanation for a charge. A driver needs a fair chance to respond. A reviewer needs reliable evidence and a clear policy basis. The first account should not become the final answer.

captions.text: A rider needs an explanation for a charge.
A driver needs a fair chance to respond.
A reviewer needs reliable evidence and a clear policy basis.
The first account should not become the final answer.

title: Start with the trip
sub: New: trip history + illustrative route cards
narration: The rider portal now adds trip history. A trip card combines the route, fare, distance, duration, and driver context. The map and trip data are synthetic, with no live telemetry connected.

captions.text: The rider portal now adds trip history.
A trip card combines the route, fare, distance, duration, and driver context.
The map and trip data are synthetic, with no live telemetry connected.

title: Report it in your own words
narration: From a trip, the rider opens a report with its reference already selected. They describe the issue, choose a category, and enter the disputed amount. Other, I’m not sure gives unclear reports an explicit route to human classification.

captions.text: From a trip, the rider opens a report with its reference already selected.

title: Advocacy is not authority
sub: Six agents + an independent policy gate
narration: The safety screen and orchestrator route the case. Rider and Driver Advocates work alongside policy and risk analysis. The Judge proposes an outcome. A separate deterministic gate checks eligibility for a simulated remedy or human review.

captions.text: The safety screen and orchestrator route the case.

A separate deterministic gate checks eligibility for a simulated remedy or human review.

title: Check facts before conclusions
sub: New: readable case facts and values
narration: The Evidence tab now shows named facts and readable values. Here, twelve dollars was quoted and sixteen fifty charged. Claims are not automatically verified; the reviewer must check provenance before relying on a fact.

captions.text: The Evidence tab now shows named facts and readable values.

title: Read the rule behind the reference
sub: New: expandable conditions, effects and evidence
narration: Rule references expand into conditions, effects, evidence requirements, and source sections. A rule identifier becomes inspectable. Routing candidates are possible matches, not rulings: the reviewer still checks whether the conditions are satisfied.

captions.text: Rule references expand into conditions, effects, evidence requirements, and source sections.

title: Inspect both sides of the case
narration: Agent Findings separates rider and driver perspectives, policy analysis, the risk check, and consistency assessment. Rule links connect those findings back to policy. This film uses offline mock mode, not verified live Gemini execution.

captions.text: Agent Findings separates rider and driver perspectives, policy analysis, the risk check, and consistency assessment.

title: Return the disputed difference
narration: The synthetic facts support an unnotified surge difference of four dollars fifty. The independent gate permits that narrow remedy. A simulated refund and mock receipt close the case. No funds move or notification is delivered.

title: Inspect the stored workflow
narration: The monitor replays stored outputs and gate results. It is explicitly a recorded replay, not live execution. Reviewers can inspect the stored process without treating a replay animation as evidence of real-time model performance.

title: A small claim can require review
narration: The route case records a four point three kilometre deviation. That triggers mandatory human review despite the small claim. Policy conditions, not just amount, determine whether automation is allowed.

captions.text: The route case records a four point three kilometre deviation.

title: Safety goes straight to a person
sub: No AI fault finding. No AI remedy ruling.
narration: A safety concern inside a fare dispute goes immediately to human review. The Judge is skipped for safety adjudication. A human independently assesses fault and remedy; the AI does not make that ruling.

captions.text: A safety concern inside a fare dispute goes immediately to human review.
The Judge is skipped for safety adjudication.

title: Unclear category? Classify first.
narration: Other reports stop automatic adjudication. A reviewer must classify the dispute before refund or credit is allowed. After reclassification, the case can be processed under the appropriate policy, while its original category remains in the audit trail.

title: Request evidence. Hear the response.
narration: A reviewer can now ask either party for more information. The driver is asked for a timestamped message or call reference. Replies remain unverified until supported by evidence.

title: Make the next step clear
narration: The rider sees a clear explanation, case progress, and the simulated refund. Unresolved cases show clarification or review as the next step. Internal investigation traces stay in the reviewer view.

title: Measure what was actually checked
sub: Local reference behavior · no cloud benchmark
narration: Locally, three hundred and forty six backend tests and eighteen frontend proxy tests passed. Fare, route, safety, and manual-classification checks exercised their expected paths. These reference checks do not measure production accuracy or cloud latency.

title: Evidence first. People in control.
sub: Fair hearing → Policy checks → Human oversight
narration: RydeResolve’s boundary is practical: use evidence and policy where automation is justified, and keep people in charge where it is not. Compare both implementations on equal terms.
